title: Policy synthesis for environment-specific constraints and shadowing strategies
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a policy synthesis and constraint-mapping subsystem that translates a single high-level rollout intent into environment-specific rollout plans for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. The subsystem should generate concrete configs (traffic weights, concurrency limits, KV cache warmup, pricing-based routing fallbacks) and a preflight simulation to validate resource/latency constraints. It must integrate with existing shadowing and auto-rollback hooks so customers can request a single declarative rollout and safely execute canaries, A/B experiments, and shadow traffic across heterogeneous environments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a declarative rollout spec (canary or A/B), the synthesize step produces three environment-specific plans: hosted.json, dedicated.json, private.json with no nested fields in the artifact metadata.
Plans must enforce environment constraints: max per-request concurrency, max canary traffic %, KV-cache warmup window, and max model size allowed for on-prem nodes.
Preflight simulator demonstrates expected p95 latency and estimated token cost for 10k req/min for each environment; deviations >20% must surface warnings.
Shadow traffic orchestration can spawn mirrored traffic to a target model in Dedicated or Private without impacting serving SLOs in Hosted (configurable throttle).

Auto-rollback triggers wired to the orchestration: rollout aborts when (error_rate > 3% for 5m) OR (latency_p95 > SLO * 1.5 for 3m) and generates a rollback plan with cross-env fallback to pinned model.

Integration tests covering: (1) canary in Hosted with Dedicated fallback, (2) A/B split between Dedicated and Hosted variants, (3) shadowing from Hosted to Private with throttling, all passing in CI pipeline.
work_log: 2026-03-05: Kickoff meeting with PM, Design and Infra. Agreed to build a policy translation layer that emits per-environment 'execution plans' and a preflight simulator. Identified required signals: queue depth, GPU memory headroom, per-model quantization compatibility.
2026-03-07: Drafted initial schema for the high-level rollout intent (mode: canary|ab|shadow, metric triggers, desired traffic percentages). Shared with design for console UX implications.
2026-03-09: Spike: simulated Dedicated capacity constraints — observed canary weight must be capped at 10% for c3-large pools due to burst-limits. Added 'capacity_cap' attribute to translation rules.
2026-03-11: Implemented a lightweight preflight simulator prototype that replays synthetic traffic profile and outputs estimated p95 & token-cost. Simulator integrated with local telemetry mock.
2026-03-13: Hooked synthesized plan generation into rollout API. Created first end-to-end sandbox flow for Hosted canary -> Dedicated bump. Manual test passing but flaky under low GPU availability.
2026-03-14: Security review kickoff — discussed KMS usage for Private payloads and audit log requirements. Action: include explicit encryption and network policy flags in generated private.json.
review_feedback: PM (Liam O'Rourke): Add explicit customer-visible explanation of why canary weights differ across environments and show cost delta estimates in Console before rollout.
Design (Sofia Ruiz): Console needs a 'preflight report' card that highlights violated constraints and recommended mitigations (e.g., reduce request concurrency, increase KV warmup).
Security (Ana Ribeiro): Private plans must include a 'no-external-calls' assertion and an HSM key path placeholder. Require a checkbox to opt in to cross-region shadowing for Private tenants.
Infra (Devon Park): For Dedicated pools with mixed GPU types, translation must avoid mixing model variants that have different kernel fallback paths; add affinity tags in plan.
implementation_notes: Design a canonical constraint model: {max_concurrency, max_canary_pct, kv_warmup_ms, allowed_quantizations, network_policy_tag, disk_swap_limit}. Stored as simple key/value strings in the plan artifact.
Policy synthesis stage: map high-level intent -> constraints by applying environment capability profiles and customer entitlements (tier, reserved_capacity).
Preflight simulator: deterministic traffic replayer + simple token-cost estimator + latency model derived from recent traces (use 30d window). Simulator outputs CSV and human-readable summary.
Shadowing: implement a throttled mirror with adjustable sampling ratio and circuit-breaker that drops mirror traffic when primary SLOs degrade beyond threshold.
Auto-rollback: wire existing rollback controller to the plan's 'rollback_policy' block. Ensure rollback emits a revert-change PR and telemetry labels for postmortem analysis.
Testing: add three CI e2e suites: fast unit-level synthesis, medium preflight sim using mock traces, slow integration with Dedicated sandbox (nightly).
Telemetry: annotate all synthesized plans with a 'plan_id' and emit plan lifecycle events to Console (create, simulate, approve, deploy, rollback).
risks: Risk: Mis-translation could accidentally open private plans to hosted routing if network_policy_tag mapping is incorrect. Mitigation: require explicit private flag and manual approval for any cross-environment traffic routing in Private tenants.
Risk: Preflight simulator model mismatch (simulated latency vs real) could cause false confidence. Mitigation: calibrate simulator weekly with real trace sampling and add confidence level to reports.
Risk: Dedicated capacity scarcity may block canaries; mitigation: include 'deferred-rollout' plan variant that automatically schedules when capacity is available and notifies SRE.
Risk: Complex policy surface increases UI cognitive load. Mitigation: provide sane defaults and a simple 'guided rollout' flow in Console.
rollback_policy: Primary triggers: error_rate > 3% sustained over 5 minutes OR p95_latency > 1.5x SLO over 3 minutes.
Graceful rollback steps: 1) pause traffic increase, 2) reduce canary to 0% over 30s, 3) promote pinned stable variant, 4) annotate plan with rollback_reason and link to failing metric snapshots.
If Dedicated capacity unavailable during rollback, route traffic to Hosted pinned model as fallback and emit alert to oncall.
deployment_matrix: Hosted: fast canaries (max 30% weight), automatic traffic shaping, KV-cache prefetch allowed, unlimited model catalog but no HSM access.
Dedicated: conservative weights (max 10% for low-capacity pools), must respect pool-affinity, can run longer canaries for A/B. Autoscaling can be requested but subject to reserved capacity rules.

Private: no external mirror by default, model size and quantization restrictions enforced, requires explicit network_policy and KMS path. Shadowing allowed only within tenant network and must be opted-in.
traffic_strategies: Canary: start at min(2%, environment_max), ramp to target over configured windows with preflight-required for Dedicated >5%.
A/B: balanced split with weight normalization by environment capacity; ensure statistical powering guidance shown to user.
Shadow: mirror 1-100% of requests; mirrored traffic is asynchronous and rate-limited to protect primary SLOs.
